theorem sum_window_le {S : Finset ℂ} (m : ℂ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 ≤ m u) {h T0 Z : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : T0 < J * h) (hS : ∀ u ∈ S, |u.im| ≤ T0) (hZ0 : 0 ≤ Z)
    (hZ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => (⌊u.im / h⌋ + J).toNat = k), m u ≤ Z)
    {f f' : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) (hf' : Continuous f') :
    ∑ u ∈ S, m u * ‖f u.im‖ ≤
      Z * ((1 / h) * (∫ t in (-(J * h))..(J * h), ‖f t‖) + ∫ t in (-(J * h))..(J * h), ‖f' t‖) :=

note: No Lean declaration cites this lemma. Erratum: The book's closing clause of Lemma 9.1.3 says that for real decreasing f the error is O*((1/4)∫_y^∞ f(T)/T dT); the proof's identity f(y)g_χ(y) − ∫f′g_χ = 0.5∫f/T is wrong (it equals 2f(y)g_χ(y) + ∫f g_χ′), so the error is only O*(f(y)g_χ(y) + (1/4)∫f/T). (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_9_1_3.py`).
